audit_type: Post-hoc read-only clearance audit of previously saved original closed-loop test trajectories
provenance: This JSON records the previously completed read-only inspection and exact aggregate results from this task's tool output. Saving this record did not rerun the simulations, alter the original experiment files, or recompute the full audit.
source_array: states[:, :2] (actual pusher center x, y; includes initial state and states after each executed control action)

calculation.negative_value_meaning: Pusher circle geometrically overlaps at least one wall interior face by -clearance length units.
calculation.violating_episode_condition: At least one saved state in the episode satisfies the violating_state_condition.
calculation.min_wall_clearance: Minimum state_clearance over all saved states in the method's 21 original test episodes.

limitations: Only saved 10 Hz control states were inspected. Physics substeps between saved states were not checked; nonnegative sampled clearance is not a substep collision-safety guarantee.
This audit measures actual pusher-circle clearance against the four original fixed walls. It does not assess T-object clearance, mechanical-arm geometry, force limits, or arbitrary obstacles.
Only the three listed original methods were inspected; this record does not claim results for visual diffusion policy, other contact seeds, or supplemental no-flow experiments.
No new independent test episodes are added. This is a diagnostic of the existing 21-scenario test set.
The kinematic pusher is not physically blocked by static walls; this geometric diagnostic must not be interpreted as a wall-reaction guarantee.

The controller's nominal action limits 21..491 do not strictly contain the radius-15 pusher within wall interior faces 7..504. Safe nominal centers without an additional tracking margin would be 22..489.
